steps.en: Install the extension from the Chrome, Firefox or Edge store
steps.zh: 从 Chrome、Firefox 或 Edge 商店装上扩展

steps.en: Keep the free Microsoft default, or add a service from a template and fill its endpoint and key
steps.zh: 用默认的微软翻译，或从模板加一个服务，填上地址和 key

steps.en: On a foreign-language page, press the translate shortcut
steps.zh: 打开外文网页，按下翻译快捷键

steps.en: Collects the page's text and sends it in batches straight to your chosen service
steps.zh: 收集页面文字，分批直接发给你选的服务

steps.en: Inserts each translation right after its original text
steps.zh: 把每段译文插在对应原文后面

value.en: Original and translation sit side by side on the page, with no middleman server in between
value.zh: 原文和译文在页面上并排对照，中间没有第三方服务器

sources: https://github.com/Cookee24/PairTranslate#privacy (requests go directly from the browser to the provider)

https://github.com/Cookee24/PairTranslate/blob/master/utils/settings/default.ts (keyboardShortcut "Alt+T", default Microsoft translator service, LLMServiceTemplates with baseUrl/apiSpec, queue requestConcurrency/maxBatchSize/tokensPerMinute)

https://github.com/Cookee24/PairTranslate/blob/master/locales/en.toml (keyboardShortcutEnabledDesc "Toggle translation with keyboard shortcut"; paragraph translation by holding Ctrl/Option and dragging)
